'''Uyohn''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[engineer]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Republic Futures Program|Futures Program]] [[Brentaal Futures Program|on]] [[Brentaal IV|Brentaal]] before being hand picked by [[Director]] [[Orson Callan Krennic|Orson Krennic]] to join [[Galen Walton Erso|Galen Erso's]] [[kyber crystal research team]].<ref name="RO NOVEL" /> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Krennic traveled to the [[Eadu Energy Conversion Laboratory]] on [[Eadu]] where the team were based after learning of Erso's betrayal. After the team had lined up in front of him, Krennic noted that Uyohn stood straight-backed expressing emotions between fear and deluded, desperate hope.<ref name="RO NOVEL" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Equipment==
While on Eadu, Uyohn wore a blue-and-white engineering [[jumpsuit]].<ref name="RO NOVEL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Uyohn, albeit unidentified, first appeared in the [[2016]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|''Star Wars'' Anthology]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="RO" /> He was first identified in the [[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (novelization)|novelization]] which was written by [[Alexander Freed]].<ref name="RO NOVEL" />
